appearances.snippet: Their objective had been to deceive civilians in Tucson. About an hour north of us, they practiced at local bars and public venues on unsuspecting people, telling lies, remembering those lies, and maintaining their false personas without quote unquote breaking character.

verification.notes: The transcript attributes this to an anonymous gym owner recounting what unnamed military students allegedly said. Official Fort Huachuca sources confirm scenario-based intelligence training, including HUMINT, but do not establish field exercises in Tucson bars using unsuspecting civilians, sexual encounters, or the described false-persona assignment. Without identifiable participants, course records, or independent evidence, the claim remains attempted/unverifiable.
